name: Library disk usage
command:
ROOT=/Users/mekari/Library; printf '%s
' '=== TOP LEVEL ALLOCATED KiB ==='; du -x -k -d1 "$ROOT" 2>&1 | sort -nr; printf '%s
' '=== TARGET CHILDREN ==='; for name in 'Application Support' Caches Containers 'Group Containers' Developer; do p="$ROOT/$name"; if [ -e "$p" ]; then printf '
--- %s ---
' "$p"; du -x -k -d2 "$p" 2>&1 | sort -nr | head -100; else printf '
--- ABSENT: %s ---
' "$p"; fi; done; printf '
=== DOCKER CLI ===
'; if command -v docker >/dev/null 2>&1; then docker system df 2>&1; else echo 'docker CLI unavailable'; fi
